# Upstream `show ip interface` samples

Copied unchanged from ntc-templates
(<https://github.com/networktocode/ntc-templates>, `tests/cisco_ios/show_ip_interface/`,
commit `77768366e7f5833275bdb45c31156bd3e1777378`), under the Apache License 2.0
in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

Captures from many switches and routers, so getters are tested against
platforms and releases we don't own rather than tailored to one. Between them
they have VRFs, a secondary address, an unnumbered tunnel and an address still
to be negotiated.
